cim: Getting a Head Start with Codex | Mitchell Hashimoto
cim_eredeti: Getting a Head Start with Codex | Mitchell Hashimoto
szoveg_eredeti:
“The whole point is I want to hit the ground running.” HashiCorp co-founder Mitchell Hashimoto wraps up his day by putting Codex agents to work. They research the competition, compare tools and prototype features he’s still working out—giving him a head start on the next day’s work.

Building with Codex? Share your story: https://openai.com/form/codex-originals/

prioritas.indok: Saját promóciós videó az OpenAI Codex használatáról, promóciós hangvételű esettanulmány. Forrás-tapasztalat: -4.
